name: Cave Bat
description: A large nocturnal bat with keen senses that thrives in the darkness of the caverns.

echolocation.description: Uses sound waves to detect movement, increasing dodge chance

sonic_screech.description: Emits a disorienting screech that damages and can briefly stun

name: Giant Rat
description: A mutated rodent that has grown to an enormous size feeding on cave fungi.

disease_bite.description: A bite that causes ongoing damage from infection

scurry.description: Quick movement that makes it harder to hit

name: Cave Slime
description: A gelatinous, acidic creature that oozes through narrow crevices and dissolves organic matter.

acid_splash.description: Sprays acid that damages and temporarily reduces defense

split.description: Regenerates some health by dividing itself

name: Crystal Spider
description: A spider with a translucent body that has adapted to life in crystal-filled caves, its exoskeleton hardened by mineral deposits.

crystal_web.description: Traps you in a crystalline web, restricting movement

crystal_shard.description: Fires sharp crystal shards that cause significant damage

name: Kobold Miner
description: A small reptilian humanoid skilled at tunneling and mining. Armed with crude picks and tools.

pickaxe_strike.description: A powerful swing that can penetrate armor

throw_dirt.description: Throws dirt in your eyes, reducing accuracy

name: Luminous Fungus
description: A sentient mushroom-like creature that emits an eerie blue glow and releases toxic spores.

spore_cloud.description: Releases a cloud of toxic spores that cause ongoing damage

hypnotic_flash.description: Emits a bright flash that can briefly stun

name: Rock Crawler
description: A large insectoid creature with a rock-like carapace and powerful pincers that can crush stone.

crushing_pincer.description: A devastating pincer attack that can crush armor

burrow.description: Quickly burrows into the ground, becoming temporarily harder to hit

name: Blind Cave Fish
description: A school of eyeless fish that swim in underground pools and have developed heightened senses to hunt in darkness.

swarm.description: The school swarms around you, dealing damage from multiple angles
